Bug fixes, correctness improvements, and optimizations

request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v for administration on behalf of the vendor MLabs.
request.what: Annual funding for maintenance and enhancement of MLabs Core Tooling: Plutarch and Ply.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,162,746 ada, consisting of 1,128,880 ada for Plutarch and Ply maintenance, compatibility, and developer experience plus a 33,866 ada Intersect administration fee.

Plutarch is described as a Haskell eDSL for creating efficient Cardano smart contracts through controlled compilation into UPLC, and Ply is described as supporting serialization to and from CIP-57 blueprint-style artifacts with inferred types.

MLabs states that Plutarch and Ply have been extensively used in the Cardano ecosystem and reports an internal audit count of at least 26 teams in the motivation section and at least 15 teams in the rationale section.

MLabs states that public cross-language benchmarks show Plutarch scripts rank among the smallest in the benchmark suite while requiring comparatively low on-chain compute and memory, and provides a benchmark URL.

The proposal says the next funding period will prioritize critical breakages and vulnerabilities, protocol-era and hard-fork compatibility, bug fixes and optimizations, then documentation and developer-experience improvements.

The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal asserts that the requested withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.

The document discloses prior MLabs-related treasury and ecosystem funding, including prior Plutarch/Ply Catalyst funding, other MLabs proposals, and 70,000 ada from Intersect for Conway-era Plutarch updates.

The proposal says funds will be administered through Intersect-controlled Treasury Reserve and Project-Specific Smart Contracts with named addresses, multi-party authorization rules, an Oversight Committee, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.
The proposal asserts that maintaining Plutarch and Ply supports Cardano 2030, developer experience, open-source tooling, and application-layer utility including DeFi, RWAs, payments, and games.

summary: The proposal is a treasury withdrawal for 1,162,746 ada to maintain and enhance Plutarch and Ply, with stated ecosystem use, technical priorities, prior funding disclosures, NCL compliance claims, and Intersect smart-contract administration and oversight arrangements.
